item.title: CSA ANNOUNCES UNMISSABLE 2026/27 HOME SEASON FOR THE PROTEAS MEN
item.description: Cricket South Africa (CSA) has today revealed the Proteas Men’s international fixtures for the 2026/27 home season, with Test cricket and One-Internationals (ODIs) headlining a busy summer against Australia, Bangladesh and England. The post CSA ANNOUNCES UNMISSABLE 2026/27 HOME SEASON FOR THE PROTEAS MEN first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: DOLPHINS GEAR UP FOR #1DAYCUP TITLE DEFENCE
item.description: The 2025/26 1 Day Cup begins this week as the country's best domestic teams battle it out for the coveted 50 over title which will close out the season. The post DOLPHINS GEAR UP FOR #1DAYCUP TITLE DEFENCE first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: Tahir back in Dolphins colours for One Day Cup
item.description: Former Proteas star Imran Tahir will return to the Hollywoodbets Dolphins on Friday when they begin their CSA One Day Cup title defence against the Dafabet Warriors in Gqeberha. The post Tahir back in Dolphins colours for One Day Cup first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: BOLAND READY TO CHASE 1 DAY CUP GLORY AFTER NEAR-MISS LAST SEASON
item.description: Goldrush Boland will begin their quest for 1 Day Cup success this weekend, determined to turn last season’s heartbreak into silverware, as they open their 2025/26 campaign against the Momentum Multiply Titans at SuperSport Park on Sunday. The post BOLAND READY TO CHASE 1 DAY CUP GLORY AFTER NEAR-MISS LAST SEASON first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: PROTEAS WOMEN’S TOURING SQUAD FOR NEW ZEALAND CONFIRMED
item.description: The South African Women’s Selection Panel has announced the Proteas Women squad that is set to embark on an outbound T20 International (T20I) and One-Day International (ODI) tour to New Zealand from 15 March - 04 April. The post PROTEAS WOMEN’S TOURING SQUAD FOR NEW ZEALAND CONFIRMED first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: PAKISTAN SURGE TO BLACK DAY ODI VICTORY OVER PROTEAS WOMEN
item.description: Pakistan marched to a 119-run triumph in the third ICC Women’s Championship (IWC) One-Day International (ODI) against the Proteas Women during the fifth edition of Black Day in Durban on Sunday. The result saw South Africa secure the series 2–1. The post PAKISTAN SURGE TO BLACK DAY ODI VICTORY OVER PROTEAS WOMEN first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: BADGERS AND DRAGONS CONTINUE WEEKEND WINNING STREAK
item.description: This Sunday’s action of the Hollywoodbets Pro Series delivered more victories for Garden Route Badgers and North West Dragons, this time in the Hollywoodbets Pro20, whilst DP World Lions and the Fidelity Titans shared the spoils in the Highveld. The post BADGERS AND DRAGONS CONTINUE WEEKEND WINNING STREAK first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: SA U19 WOMEN SET FOR T20I INVITATIONAL IN NIGERIA AS WORLD CUP PREPARATIONS CONTINUE
item.description: Cricket South Africa (CSA) is pleased to announce the South Africa Under-19 Women’s participation in the Nigeria Cricket Federation (NCF) Women’s T20 International (T20I) Invitational tournament in Lagos from 18–29 March. The post SA U19 WOMEN SET FOR T20I INVITATIONAL IN NIGERIA AS WORLD CUP PREPARATIONS CONTINUE first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: DE VILLIERS AND PETERS HELP WARRIORS SLAY DRAGONS
item.description: The Dafabet Warriors claimed a hard-fought 11-run victory over NWU North West Dragons after defending a competitive total of 262/8 in their 1Day Cup encounter on Tuesday. The post DE VILLIERS AND PETERS HELP WARRIORS SLAY DRAGONS first appeared on Cricket South Africa.

item.title: LIONS AND WP WITH BOOSTING VICTORIES
item.description: It was a good day on Wednesday for the DP World Lions and World Sports Betting Western Province who beat the Hollywoodbets Dolphins and Goldrush Boland, respectively, to boost their chances of a 1Day Cup play-off spot. The post LIONS AND WP WITH BOOSTING VICTORIES first appeared on Cricket South Africa.
